record.question: The patient died before the doctor could remove the tumour. Pick out the correct clause of the underlined words.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. “Before the doctor could remove the tumour” gives the time of the patient’s death; it is an adverb clause. Independent check: “Before the doctor could remove the tumour” states when the patient died, so it is an adverbial time clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
